sbh2.5:4.8: Printed *jārito jārita*; read *jvarito jvarita* (Xuanzang 蒸熱, T1579 juan 27).
sbh2.5:4.15: Printed text omits the close (Shukla p. 215 n. 1); Xuanzang has it (名外火界, T1579 juan 27).
sbh2.5:5.11: *pippalaka*, a wind Xuanzang transliterates rather than translates (小刀風、大刀風、針刺風、畢鉢羅風, T1579 juan 27).
sbh2.5:5.19: *viśva* and *vairambha* are wind names; Xuanzang transliterates both (毘濕婆風, 吠藍婆風, T1579 juan 27).
sbh2.5:5.25: Printed text ends at *evaṁbhāgīyaḥ*; Xuanzang has the close (名外風界, T1579 juan 27).
sbh2.5:7.3: Printed *cittaṁ manovijñānaṁ ca*; read *cittaṁ mano vijñānaṁ ca* (Xuanzang 心、意、識, T1579 juan 27; cf. sbh2.6:10.7).
